description: Fork of exp248 (1.6071 @ 8K, soft LUT learnable T_soft/T_sel). Single change: out_v2d gains a learnable temperature (log-parametrized like soft LUT temps), initialized at 0.5 instead of canon_temperature=0.1. Goal: let optimizer pick V2D backward sharpness per layer. Also dumps a separate temperatures.csv with all learnable temps (per-LUT T_soft/T_sel + per-layer V2D temperature) at every eval step for later dynamics analysis.
